description: This file defines a utility class 'Env' that provides access to environment variables related to API configuration, with default fallback values. It facilitates retrieving the API mode ('mock' or 'live') and the base URL for API calls, handling absent or invalid environment variables gracefully.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for accessing environment variables related to API configuration with default values.

methods.name: apiMode
methods.description: Returns the current API mode, defaulting to 'mock' if not specified or invalid.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL for API calls, defaulting to a placeholder URL if not specified.
